metaDescription: Hospitality deserves better judgment, not more software. Why RADR exists.
heroLead: Hospitality is intensely human in front of the guest and brutally operational behind the scenes. Thousands of small decisions determine whether revenue becomes contribution. RADR exists to improve those decisions.
decisionsLead: Thousands of signals. A few decisions that materially change revenue, contribution, cost, guest experience and operational risk.
hospitalityLead1: Restaurants, hotels, and serviced apartments share one decision engine — different economics, same loop.
hospitalityLead2: That operating truth is the product thesis, not a vertical skin.
ambitionLead: One operating language across every location.
contactHeroLead: Vous voulez savoir ce que RADR trouverait dans votre exploitation ?
securityLead: How RADR earns trust on decisions and data.

body: RADR a été conçu pour connecter les preuves et montrer aux opérateurs ce qui compte.

why.metaTitle: Why RADR · Hospitality has a decision problem
why.metaDescription: The data already exists. The operating judgment is fragmented. RADR owns the decision lifecycle across systems.
why.leadProduce: The data already exists. The operating judgment is fragmented.
why.leadFragments: Each system knows a slice. The decision crosses all four.
why.leadFewAnswer: RADR owns the decision lifecycle — and answers:
questions: What happens if we do nothing?

territories.RECOVER: Credits, cancellations, uncollected and perishable value.

approach.metaTitle: Our approach · Not more data. Better decisions.
approach.metaDescription: RADR surfaces material decisions, plays futures forward, prepares action, and verifies value — then learns.
approach.heroLead: Rien hors de RADR. Nous relions la réalité opérationnelle à la conséquence financière, et la transformons en action.

principles.title: La conséquence financière d'abord.
principles.body: Ne faites pas apparaître quelque chose simplement parce que cela a changé. Faites-le apparaître quand cela compte.

principles.title: La preuve avant les alertes.
principles.body: Chaque finding RADR doit expliquer pourquoi il existe.

principles.title: L'action plutôt que l'observation.
principles.body: Un dashboard vous dit ce qui s'est passé. RADR doit aider à déterminer ce qui se passe ensuite.

principles.title: La valeur doit être prouvable.
principles.body: La valeur Identified n'est pas la valeur réalisée. RADR distingue Identified, Protected et Verified.

identified.label: Identified
identified.desc: La différence financière est connue et étayée.

protected.label: Protected
protected.desc: Un control ou une action est en place pour empêcher la récurrence.

verified.label: Verified
verified.desc: La valeur a réellement été capturée, avec preuve.

securityPage.metaTitle: Trust & Security · Decision trust and honest controls
securityPage.metaDescription: Decision trust: evidence grades, human approval for material actions, Verified Value chain — plus the access and data controls that actually exist.
securityPage.heroLead: RADR separates OBSERVED, ESTIMATED, OPERATOR CONTEXT, PREDICTED, RECOMMENDED and VERIFIED. Predictions are estimates — not guarantees. Human approval for material actions. No Verified Value without an evidence chain.

privateStorage.label: Stockage documentaire privé
privateStorage.detail: Les PDF et images uploadés sont stockés en object storage privé (ou en store local privé en développement), pas dans des buckets publics.

orgIsolation.label: Isolation d'organisation
orgIsolation.detail: L'accès aux documents et comptes est limité côté serveur à l'appartenance d'organisation authentifiée.

serverAuthz.label: Autorisation côté serveur
serverAuthz.detail: Les routes et API protégées vérifient la session et l'appartenance avant de renvoyer des données sensibles.

controlledDocs.label: Accès documentaire contrôlé
controlledDocs.detail: La lecture et le téléchargement de documents exigent une authentification ; les chemins d'accès ne sont pas énumérables publiquement.

sessionAuth.label: Authentification de session
sessionAuth.detail: Les sessions de compte sont gérées par Better Auth avec validation de session côté serveur.

auditExports.label: Exports d'audit avancés
auditExports.detail: Pistes d'audit exportables pour les opérateurs et les équipes finance.

securityPage.certNote: Aucune revendication de certification SOC 2 ou ISO n'est faite ici. Le RGPD est un cadre juridique, pas une certification que nous revendiquons. Lorsque des certifications formelles existent, elles seront listées avec dates et périmètre.
securityPage.questionsPrefix: Questions sur le traitement des données ?
securityPage.trustLead: Operators should know what is fact, what is estimate, and what still needs a human.

trustPrinciples.title: Evidence before advice
trustPrinciples.detail: Material recommendations carry sources, freshness, drivers and confidence — not chatty tips.

trustPrinciples.title: Grade every claim
trustPrinciples.detail: OBSERVED · ESTIMATED · PREDICTED · RECOMMENDED · VERIFIED stay distinct. RADR does not blur them.

trustPrinciples.title: Human approval for material actions
trustPrinciples.detail: Prepared for approval is not execution. External action only through supported systems and organization policy.

trustPrinciples.title: Verified Value chain
trustPrinciples.detail: Potential stays separate until observed proof lands. RADR claims only what the operation can prove.

securityPage.controlsLead: Only controls that actually exist. Status is LIVE or IN DEVELOPMENT — never aspirational theater.
securityPage.uncertaintyTitle: What if reality does something else?
securityPage.uncertaintyLead: RADR compares predicted vs actual, then updates. Humility is a feature.
securityPage.uncertaintyNote: RADR does not need to be right every time. It needs to measure when it was wrong — and learn.
securityPage.modelNote: Model confidence is calculated from the model, sample size, and data freshness. Evidence coverage is factual. They are not the same.
securityPage.opsNote: RADR provides operational decision support. It is not investment, legal, tax, or regulated financial advice. Managers approve material actions.

customers.metaDescription: Des exploitations réelles. Des findings réels. De la valeur réelle. Les études de cas RADR arrivent bientôt.
customers.heroLead: Études de cas à venir. Quand elles arriveront, chacune suivra la même forme que le produit : exploitation, problème, finding, action, Verified Value.

control.label: Control Center
control.title: Only what needs you.
control.body: Attention load, what RADR is handling, verified since last check.

value.label: Verified Value
value.title: Claim only what you can prove.
value.body: Exposure becomes expected, observed, then verified — with proof.

memory.label: Operating Memory
memory.title: The operation remembers.
memory.body: Every verified outcome makes the next decision better.

founder.quote: I thought I wanted to open a restaurant. What I really wanted was to make hospitality work better.
founder.name: Daniel Do
founder.body: Grew up close to hospitality through a family food business, worked in hospitality, then technology and sales. The deeper problem was not another venue — it was the operating system behind thousands of venues. RADR is the larger expression of that obsession.

items.title: Humans provide the hospitality.
items.body: Software should reduce work, not create it.

items.title: Claim only what you can prove.
Start with what you have.
items.body: Files, APIs, or a mature stack — RADR meets you there.
